verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk capability, such as batch triggering or bulk cancel/replay of many runs at once. What it does show is per-run handles for cancelling or retrying a single run, a filtered runs.list query, and concurrency limits. These are single-item actions or developer building blocks, not bulk operations, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
